styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium smart-home ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep navy-blue tile backdrop #3A4A5E, deep-blue banner #3D4D6E, clean white section base #FFFFFF, soft mist-grey card base #E8EAED, and one cyan-tech accent #37C8E8; cool neutral lighting; modern geometric sans-serif headlines and labels; consistent rounded rectangular info labels and thin-line white icons in rounded squares; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable product scale and placement; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 12 张 800x1200 详情页切片提炼。纠正：源文件夹名为「家装家具家用品」，但实际主产品为全自动智能门锁，按 taxonomy 判定为 手机数码/智能家居。已剥离：型号字样、店铺会员二维码、具体供应商名（指纹头品牌）与具体参数数字（响应时间/容量/适用年龄均走 callout 文案槽由使用方填写）、源图文案；源图中人物与实拍照片在源素材里已被涂为纯色块，仅保留版式结构信息，升级时对应图区改为图内直接呈现的实拍卡片。关键假设：shot-06 三个数据点为感应时间/指纹容量/适用范围类卖点，走 callout 文案槽；shot-08 细件卡对应触屏面板与滑盖两类细节，文案全部走 callout 文案槽。
